capabilities: chat with selectable mentor personas (e.g. Socrates, Steve Jobs)
explain selected text in simple terms (ELI5)
redact prose from a selected bullet-point list
query OpenAI or Perplexity models, including web-connected pplx models
extras: README is partly developer-oriented (clone, npm install, manual install steps) and repeats the template warning that the Obsidian API is in early alpha; an OpenAI API key is mandatory in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to ask an AI for advice or to have selected text explained, redacted from bullet points, or corrected in place.

relations.evidence: this plugin can use both OpenAI APIs and Perplexity APIs
you can use pplx-*b-online models, meaning your answer will always be up-to-date

summary: AI chat plugin that answers questions through mentor personas and rewrites selected note text using OpenAI or Perplexity models.
